title: MCP wire head doesn't plumb project context to surface evaluation
wanted_capability: Project-scoped surface routing packets reachable through the wire MCP head (?surface=...), not only through the dispatch path
notes: surface_entry() and surface_entry_sync() in src/server/handler.rs hardcode None for project on every call into cached_surface_entry / evaluate_tool_surface. The evaluator and cache already support project-scoped packet resolution (load_latest_by_domain with project), and dispatch_surface_filters() already plumbs project through — so the dispatch path works correctly. But an MCP client connecting to /mcp?surface=readonly can never hit a project-scoped surface packet, because the initialize handler doesn't know which project the session belongs to. Fix would require: (1) a way for MCP session init to carry project identity (header? separate URL path? mcp_name registration metadata?), and (2) threading that into surface_entry/surface_entry_sync.
